福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

風神廟The God of Wind Temple

認識接官亭、神界氣象局的五位神明，還有為什麼風神廟用「木行」馬背。

Meet the divine weather bureau, the stone arch, and the wood-shaped horseback.

想像乘著木造帆船橫渡台灣海峽：沒有氣象預報、沒有引擎，只有風和你的祈禱。這座 1739 年的廟，是全台唯一供奉風神的廟宇。從大陸來的官員下船、穿過石坊，先向風神道謝，感謝撿回一條命。廟裡是「神界氣象局」：風神坐鎮中央，左邊紅色火神，右邊藍色水神。祭壇兩側是雷公和電母。屋頂為什麼用木行馬背？風看不見，樹搖了你才看見風，所以用木代表風。

Imagine crossing the Taiwan Strait in a wooden sailboat, with no weather forecast and no engine. Only the wind, and your prayers. This temple, built in 1739, is the only one in Taiwan dedicated to the God of Wind. Officials from the mainland stepped off the boat, walked through the stone arch, and thanked the Wind God for their lives. Inside is a divine weather bureau. The Wind God sits in the middle, with the red God of Fire and the blue God of Water. Beside the altar stand Lei Gong, the Thunder God, and Dian Mu, the Goddess of Lightning. Why a wood-shaped horseback on the roof? Wind is invisible. You only see it when the trees shake, so wood stands for wind.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 官員的第一站風神廟建於 1739 年，在南河港西門旁。官員與使節由南河港上岸，也由此離台。Officials and envoys arrived and departed by the Nanhe Channel.
  2. 神界氣象局在沒有天氣預報的年代，想申請一路順風，就來這裡。This was where you filed your request for fair weather.
  3. 門神：潘岳雄的彩繪推開廟門，門上是兩位面對面的武將門神，出自台南彩繪名師潘岳雄之手。Two warrior door gods face each other on the temple doors, painted by the Tainan master Pan Yue-hsiung.
  4. 屋頂上的五行山牆尖端鼓起的部分叫「馬背」，有金木水火土五種造型。The horseback comes in five shapes, one for each of the Five Elements.

認識景點

About the place

官員的第一站The officials' first stop

全台唯一：供奉風神的廟宇。 接官亭石坊：官員渡海平安抵達，先穿過石坊，再到後方謝神。 渡海：木造帆船、沒有氣象預報、沒有引擎。 做十六歲：相傳台南「做十六歲」的習俗，是從南河港的郭姓碼頭工人開始的。

The only one in Taiwan: The only temple in Taiwan dedicated to the God of Wind. Official Reception Stone Arch: Officials passed through the arch and went behind it to give thanks. crossing: No weather forecast and no engine, only the wind. Turning sixteen: By tradition, the turning-sixteen rite began with dock workers on this channel.

黑龜穴傳說：民間傳說（相傳）：乾隆初年，南河港一帶是「黑龜穴」風水寶地，能出大人物；傳說清朝官府怕這裡出人才，就蓋風神廟壓住龜身。黑龜還會揮動頭和腳、興風作浪，於是知府蔣元樞在廟前蓋石坊壓住龜頭、蓋碑亭壓住前腳，從此船隻平安進出。廟裡的解說牌也說：這個傳說的來源難以考證。

the Black Turtle legend: Legend says a giant black turtle lay under the old harbor here. It was a lucky spot that could produce great leaders, and the legend says the Qing rulers wanted to stop that. So the Wind God Temple was built on the turtle's back. The turtle still waved its head and legs and stirred up wind and waves. So Prefect Jiang Yuanshu built the stone arch on its head and stone pavilions on its front legs. After that, boats sailed safely. It is only a folk legend, and no one knows where it came from.

神界氣象局The divine weather bureau

風神：坐鎮中央，是後方最大的黑色神像。右手拿如意，左手拿風葫蘆（風壺）；相傳葫蘆裡裝著天地間各種風，微風、狂風都由他控制。 如意與風葫蘆：如意代表吉祥如意，也象徵讓天氣平順；風葫蘆相傳裝著風，風神打開葫蘆，就能放出微風或狂風。到現場請找找看：右手如意、左手葫蘆。 火神：紅色的火神在風神左邊。 水神：藍色的水神在風神右邊。

the God of Wind: The Wind God presides in the middle. He holds a ruyi in his right hand and a wind gourd in his left. The gourd holds every kind of wind. ruyi and wind gourd: The ruyi stands for good luck and smooth weather. The wind gourd holds the wind: the Wind God opens it to let out a breeze or a storm. On site, find the ruyi in his right hand and the gourd in his left. the God of Fire: The red God of Fire is on his left. the God of Water: The blue God of Water is on his right.

雷公：祭壇左側；鳥嘴鳥爪，手拿斧和鑿，腳踩著鼓。 電母：祭壇右側；手持雙鏡。 電母的故事：傳說有位守寡的媳婦，把白米留給婆婆吃，自己只吃米糠，吃不完的米糠就倒掉。有一天她把米糠倒進水溝，剛好被雷公看到。雷公以為她糟蹋糧食，一聲雷就把她打死了。玉皇大帝知道這是雷公犯下的大錯，為了補償她，便封她為「電母」，許配給雷公為妻。

Lei Gong, the Thunder God: He has a bird beak, an axe and a chisel, and drums. Dian Mu, the Goddess of Lightning: She holds two mirrors. Dian Mu's story: A young widow gave the white rice to her mother-in-law and ate only the rice husks herself. One day, Lei Gong saw her pour the leftover husks into a ditch. He thought she was wasting food, and he struck her dead with thunder. The Jade Emperor knew Lei Gong had made a terrible mistake. To make it up to her, he made her Dian Mu, the Goddess of Lightning, and Lei Gong's wife.

門神：潘岳雄的彩繪Door gods painted by Pan Yue-hsiung

左扇門神：臉色較白、眼神沉穩，長鬚一根根畫出來。 右扇門神：臉色較深、怒目圓睜，看起來更威猛。 潘岳雄：台南「潘家」彩繪第三代：祖父潘春源、父親潘麗水。1977 年第一件獨立作品就是法華寺的門神。 門神要華麗：父親潘麗水教他：「壁畫、樑枋畫要雅氣，門神彩繪要華麗。」

door god (left): A fair face, calm eyes, and a long beard painted hair by hair. door god (right): A darker face and fierce, wide eyes. Pan Yue-hsiung: A third-generation temple painter from Tainan's Pan family. His first solo work was a pair of door gods. splendid door gods: His father taught him: murals should be elegant, but door gods should be splendid.

欣賞重點：① 滿身金色線條勾出的盔甲花紋；② 頭盔上展翅的鳥和兩側飄帶；③ 一根根細畫的長鬍鬚；④ 兩位一靜一怒的表情對比；⑤ 腰間護甲上的獸面。兩扇門關起來時，兩位武將正好面對面守住廟門。 神龕後的龍：正殿神像背後的龍也是潘岳雄畫的。龍爪抓著旗、球、戟、磬，諧音「祈求吉慶」。

what to look for: Look for the gold lines on the armor, the bird on each helmet, the long beards painted hair by hair, one calm face and one fierce face, and the beast face at the waist. When the doors close, the two warriors face each other to guard the temple. the dragon behind the altar: Pan also painted the dragon behind the main altar. Its claws hold a flag, a ball, a halberd and a chime: in Chinese, the words sound like a wish for good fortune.

屋頂上的五行Five Elements on the roof

木行馬背：風看不見，只有樹木搖動時你才看見風，所以五行以木代表風。

wood-shaped horseback: Wind is invisible. You only see it when the trees shake. So wood represents wind.

關鍵詞彙Key words

風神：坐鎮中央，是後方最大的黑色神像。右手拿如意，左手拿風葫蘆（風壺）；相傳葫蘆裡裝著天地間各種風，微風、狂風都由他控制。

the God of Wind: The Wind God presides in the middle. He holds a ruyi in his right hand and a wind gourd in his left. The gourd holds every kind of wind.

實景照片

Photos on site

接官亭石坊：清代官員上岸後先穿過這座石坊

The Official Reception Stone Arch — officials walked through it after landing.

石坊背面：橫匾刻著「鰲柱擎天」（由右往左讀）。「鰲」是傳說中的大海龜，相傳牠的腳被當成柱子，撐起了天。

The back of the stone arch. Its four carved words mean "the sea turtle's pillars hold up the sky." In an old legend, the legs of a giant sea turtle were used to hold up the sky.

穿過石坊，風神廟就在正後方

Walk through the stone arch and the God of Wind Temple is right behind it.

風神廟的紅色山牆，屋頂邊上彎彎的是「馬背」。右邊是金爐，刻著「風調沐暖春」；拜拜後，大家在這裡燒金紙給神明。

The temple's red side wall. The curved top of the gable is called the horseback. On the right is the paper furnace, where people burn paper money for the gods.

正殿：後方最大的黑色神像是風神（右手如意、左手風葫蘆）；兩旁是雷公、電母

The main altar: the large dark statue at the back is the God of Wind, with a ruyi and a wind gourd. Lei Gong and Dian Mu stand on either side.

走進正殿：上方匾額寫著「和以被物」，意思是風神的恩澤像微風，溫和地照顧萬物。桌圍上繡著「風神廟」；照片左邊是電母，右邊是雷公。

Inside the main hall. The plaque at the top says the Wind God's kindness covers all things, gently, like a breeze. The altar cloth says God of Wind Temple. The Goddess of Lightning is on the left of the photo, and the Thunder God is on the right.

神像背後的龍：潘岳雄所畫，龍爪抓著旗、球、戟、磬，諧音「祈求吉慶」

The dragon behind the altar was painted by Pan Yue-hsiung. Its claws hold a flag, a ball, a halberd and a chime.

後方最大的黑色神像就是風神：右手如意，左手風葫蘆

The large dark statue at the back is the God of Wind: a ruyi in his right hand, a wind gourd in his left.

紅色的火神

The red God of Fire.

藍色的水神

The blue God of Water.

雷公：手拿斧和鑿，腳踩著鼓

Lei Gong, the Thunder God, with an axe and a chisel, standing on his drums.

電母：高舉鏡子，閃出亮光

Dian Mu, the Goddess of Lightning, holding up her mirrors.

潘岳雄畫的門神（左扇）：金線盔甲、頭盔上的鳥、一根根的長鬍鬚

Door god by Pan Yue-hsiung (left): gold-lined armor, a bird on the helmet, a beard painted hair by hair.

潘岳雄畫的門神（右扇）：怒目圓睜，和左扇一靜一怒

Door god by Pan Yue-hsiung (right): fierce eyes, a contrast to the calm face on the left.

「風馳神行」「溥暢萬物」匾額，牆上畫著接官亭石坊

Old plaques praising the Wind God, and a painting of the stone arch on the wall.

「功同日月」匾額與石坊圓形壁畫

A plaque saying the god's merit equals the sun and moon, above a round painting of the arch.
